gen-zen-dots-gf-kulim-park: Kulim Park reads friendly and unfussy, its terminals ending exactly as wide as they started. And Zen Dots, with all that room around each letter, gives the pair a spacious, techy confidence.
gen-zen-dots-gf-kumbh-sans: Zen Dots spreads out with a friendly, techy grin, every shape given generous space. Then Kumbh Sans, a sans-serif drawn as if with a fixed pen, holds the line with cut-short terminals.
gen-zen-dots-gf-lato: Zen Dots is the tech-flavored showpiece with generous room around every letter. Lato, a plain sans, does the quieter job of keeping wide s curves easy to follow.
gen-zen-dots-gf-libre-franklin: Libre Franklin carries a splayed c terminal and a professional tone. Above it, Zen Dots brings a friendly, techy look with generous room around every letter, and that spacious character is what the pair does best.
gen-zen-dots-gf-livvic: Round, friendly and a bit futuristic, with Zen Dots roomy up top and Livvic below keeping curves free of stress or swelling. One is made to be noticed; the plain sans is made to be read.
gen-zen-dots-gf-lunasima: Lunasima has a clean, contemporary look, its c tips never creeping toward touching, and Zen Dots stands above it with room around every letter. Over many lines the sans stays comfortably open.
gen-zen-dots-gf-lxgw-marker-gothic: Zen Dots gives every letter generous room and a techy, friendly face. Below it, LXGW Marker Gothic keeps a wide-open c and a smooth, modest weight gradient, so a long passage moves along without strain.
gen-zen-dots-gf-m-plus-1: Zen Dots lays out a friendly, techy heading with generous room around every letter, while M PLUS 1 sits below with big open eyes on every e and a. The heading grabs attention; the sans-serif just keeps reading.
gen-zen-dots-gf-m-plus-1p: Zen Dots is friendly and techy, with generous openings at every weight. Its strongest quality is that spaciousness, which M PLUS 1p echoes in a sans that stays open at every curve end.
gen-zen-dots-gf-m-plus-2: M PLUS 2 reads approachably, with a gaping c opening and one fixed nib width. Under Zen Dots, whose letters are given generous room, a long passage would feel open and steady.
